candidates.change_summary: Replace the address creation so the new EmergencyOracle is deployed with a fixed owner (jojoTeam) instead of msg.sender, changing the newOracle address returned and emitted.
Emit the event before deploying the EmergencyOracle, so the emitted newOracle address (zero at that moment) differs from the original behavior.
Return the newly created oracle address as msg.sender in the event (swap emitted owner), altering the observed event owner field while keeping deployment unchanged.
Relax the modifier to require the caller be the zero address (making the function effectively inaccessible and preventing creation/emission), changing observable state after call attempts.
Invert the check so any caller except jojoTeam may call, changing who can successfully create and thus the observed newEmergencyOracle.
